description.content:
[operation: rule-list]



READ-ONLY



Returns active routing rules (ExplicitV1 builder only; legacy excluded).

- page (opt): 0-indexed page number, default 0

- pageSize (opt): rules per page, default 200

- workspaceId (opt): filter to rules in a specific workspace

- name (opt): filter rules by name

→

    {results: [{type, id, workspaceId, name, conditions, ruleBuilderVersion, product?, metadata: {revision, ...}, teamId?}], total, page, pageSize}

⚠ always call immediately before rule-modify/rule-delete to get a fresh revision — stale revision causes conflict error

see: rule-get (fetch single rule by id), rule-modify (update rule), rule-delete (remove rule)

query.description: Page number. First page has index 0.
